settings.video_device_description: An existing, readable/writable loopback device reserved for scrcpy. The plugin never loads kernel modules or kills other sessions.
settings.auto_mirror: Start the preview when the panel opens
settings.hide_when_disconnected: Hide the bar widget when disconnected

devices.automatic: ADB target — matched automatically to this phone
devices.waiting_adb: Waiting for this phone’s ADB connection. Wireless discovery will retry automatically.

status.idle: Preview stopped. Select an ADB target and start the mirror.
status.starting: Starting scrcpy and the live feed…
status.streaming: Live preview — tap or drag to control the selected phone.
status.error: The preview could not start. Check the device and dependencies.

setup.adb: Enable USB or Wireless debugging, accept this computer on Android, then select an authorized ADB target. KDE Connect is not required.

rename.name: Device nickname
rename.local_only: Saved only in AndroidConnect. Leave blank to restore the original name.

wireless.idle: Select a phone or enter its host to discover Wireless ADB.
wireless.scanning: Finding this phone’s current Wireless ADB port and reconnecting…
wireless.connected: Wireless ADB connected. The control target is selected automatically.
wireless.timeout: No connection yet. Enable Wireless debugging and pair if needed, then use Find port to retry.
wireless.scan_qr: On Android, choose Pair device with QR code and scan this code.
wireless.instructions: Android → Developer options → Wireless debugging. Pairing and connect ports are different. KDE Connect cannot enable Android debugging for you.

notice.paired: ADB paired. Finding the phone’s current connect port automatically.
notice.connected: ADB connected. AndroidConnect will match it to the selected phone.
notice.qr_expired: QR pairing timed out. Generate a new code to retry.

errors.action: AndroidConnect could not complete the action.
errors.busy: Too many pending actions. Wait for the current action to finish and retry.
errors.recording: Recording could not be downloaded. The remote file has been kept for recovery.
errors.companion: The AndroidConnect companion is not responding. Reload the plugin and check its logs.
